Which companies mine graphite in Mozambique?
Thought for 7s

The table has 2 rows, all for “Graphite”. Operators, as printed: GK Ancuabe Graphite Mine SA. and Syrah Resources Ltd.

*(Note: USGS prints no capacity for either row, and capacity is not production.

National Output Context

In global production, Mozambique ranks 5th worldwide for natural graphite, producing an estimated 60,000 t (estimated) in 2025 (a 3.3% world share out of a total 1,800,000 t), according to the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026.

Graphite facilities in Mozambique — USGS Minerals Yearbook 2019
Operator	Owners and shares, as printed	Location
GK Ancuabe Graphite Mine SA.	Graphit Kropfmühl GmbH, 90%, and Empresa Moçambicana de Exploração Mineira, S.A. (EMEM), 10%	Ancuabe graphite mine, Cabo Delgado Province
Syrah Resources Ltd.	Twigg Exploration and Mining Limitada, 100%	Balama Graphite operation, Cabo Delgado Province

Every cell is copied from the USGS table as printed. Capacity is capacity, not production. The table names no buyers. USGS Minerals Yearbook, volume III (Area Reports: International), country chapters, Table 2. Structure of the mineral industry (Table 2) ↗
